title: Sulfurization run (lab draft)
summary: Prepare cooling and argon, purge the tube, load sulfur and the chip, reassemble the furnace, and program and start the run. Edited draft organised from the lab's own notes; not yet validated as an operating procedure. Open points are marked 'To confirm'.

steps.title: Prepare the cooling system
steps.body: Get ice and place the water cooler in the ice bath.
steps.caution: Keep water lines away from electrics.

steps.title: Check the argon supply
steps.body: Check that the argon pressure gauge reads above 5 psi.
steps.caution: To confirm: which gauge the 5 psi limit refers to, and the maximum allowed pressure.
steps.check: Argon gauge reads above 5 psi (confirm gauge)

steps.title: Close the outlet to the fume hood for purging
steps.body: Confirm that the outlet hose leading to the fume hood is closed during the purge sequence. The intention is to fill the tube with argon and then evacuate it, rather than maintain continuous flow.

steps.title: Evacuate the tube
steps.body: Evacuate the tube using the vacuum connection on the left.

steps.title: Close the vacuum valve and admit argon
steps.body: Close the vacuum valve, then admit argon to fill the tube.

steps.title: Close the argon valve and evacuate again
steps.body: Close the argon valve and evacuate the tube again. Repeat steps 4–6 until three full cycles are complete.
steps.caution: To confirm: whether purging must be repeated after loading the sample.

steps.title: Release vacuum and remove the thermocouple
steps.body: Release the vacuum, then remove the thermocouple before withdrawing the tube assembly.
steps.caution: To confirm: the vacuum-release step before opening — never pull the assembly against vacuum.

steps.title: Withdraw the tube assembly to the right
steps.body: Withdraw the tube assembly toward the right.

steps.title: Load sulfur and the chip in the boat
steps.body: Load approximately 1–2 g of sulfur and the chip using the sample boat.
steps.caution: To confirm: chip placement — the notes describe it both on the boat and next to the boat.

steps.title: Reinsert the tube assembly and thermocouple
steps.body: Reinsert and close the tube assembly, then reinstall the thermocouple.

steps.title: Close the furnace housing
steps.check: Tube assembly seated, thermocouple installed, housing closed

steps.title: Enter the temperature program
steps.body: Enter the intended temperature program on the controller (SOP: program __ ). The published MoSe2 sequence is 700 °C for 10 min, sulfur purge, then 900 °C for 5 min; use this sequence if that is the intended program.
steps.caution: To confirm: exhaust and valve configuration during heating.

steps.title: Start the run once the checks are complete
steps.body: Start the procedure once the required checks are complete.
steps.check: Cooling bath in place, argon above the limit, outlet configured as required
